NOTE ON WHAT IS AND IS NOT IN THIS DIRECTORY.
The `quartus_map` / `quartus_fit` / `quartus_sta` STAGE LOGS were removed after
the run; they are ~1.5 MB of tool chatter and nothing in
`phase_split_anatomy_2026-09-08.md` is derived from them.  What IS retained is
every file a figure is read from: the scan outputs (`seed*.phasesplit.txt`),
the per-class ceiling probe (`seed*.truefmax.txt`), the frontier attribution
(`seed1.frontier.txt`), Quartus's own timing summary (`seed*.sta.summary`) and
the fitter's seed echo (`seed*.seedecho.txt`).

⚠ THIS IS NOT A RECEIPT AND THIS DIRECTORY IS NOT A GATE ARTIFACT.  The
quotable Fmax numbers come from `sw/quartus_gate.py`; `seed*.truefmax.txt` is
one draw of one probe and `standing_gates.md` §A governs.

The `seed1.frontier.txt` in this directory was taken on a SEPARATE re-fit of
CONTROL seed 1 (same map, same `--seed=1 --recompile=off`), run after the three
scan draws because each fit overwrites `hdl/db`.
